[[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV's]] '''Council of Human High Culture''' was the organization that proposed the idea of staging a production of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], which it achieved with the backing of several large and prominent Brentaal commerce houses.
